Apple screenshots: 1.3(vi) bars copying or extracting; 1.3(ii) bars removing legal notices; repo copies keep the wordmark and Legal link. Owner decides before any push.
Zoom gaps: nothing 5.4-11.6, none above 16.0; a zoom 8-9 and a zoom 17 frame would complete the set.
POIs and district layers: none in README s3; use a self-hosted OSM extract (ODbL, no bulk tile use) or leave them out.
